ideas.pitch: An AI-powered coastal erosion and storm surge monitoring dashboard that integrates satellite imagery to help local South Florida municipalities track vulnerability hotspots.
ideas.title: MiamiSeaGuard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targets a regional and environmental problem that judges in Miami feel directly, matching the pattern of solving localized issues with high measurable impact.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous micro-finance escrow agent leveraging USDC on Base for peer-reviewed community hurricane relief funds and resource sharing in South Florida.
ideas.title: BiscayneBails
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes established patterns of autonomous agents and blockchain escrow that historically win ecosystem tracks.

ideas.pitch: A computer vision and generative AI platform tailored for marine biology researchers in Florida to automatically categorize coral reef health from underwater drone footage.
ideas.title: CoralCare AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines cutting-edge multimodal AI with local environmental conservation, appealing directly to regional judges and academic stakeholders.

ideas.pitch: A hyper-local senior citizen mobility and social meetup planner designed specifically to coordinate volunteer drivers and group activities across Miami-Dade county neighborhoods.
ideas.title: SunshineSync
